name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

eligibility.other_conditions: Urban and peri-urban street vendors vending on or before March 24, 2020. Must possess Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from ULB.

benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of initial Rs 10,000, followed by Rs 20,000 in second tranche and Rs 50,000 in third tranche on timely repayment. 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account and cashback on digital transactions up to Rs 1,200/year.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending / ID Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
application_process: Apply online via PM SVANidhi portal or through local Urban Local Body (ULB) / Common Service Centre (CSC).
Upload Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation from Municipal Ward Officer.
Lending institution reviews application and directly disburses loan into bank account.
